title: Mutually including files are processed once each
rule: Files that include each other are each processed once and resolution terminates.

provisional.question: Looker's resulting order for mutually including files is not documented, and the tool must terminate either way. The expectation b also depends on r06's open question: the model includes a.view.lkml, which includes b.view.lkml before it defines orders, so the refinement in b can be read before the view it refines. If Looker does not apply a refinement read before its base view, orders resolves to raw.orders.

citations.quote: Within a project, refinements are applied in the order in which their files are included.
